vulg: Paulus apostolus Christi Iesu per voluntatem Dei secundum promissionem vitae quae est in Christo Iesu
clem: Paulus Apostolus Jesu Christi per voluntatem Dei, secundum promissionem vit, qu est in Christo Jesu,
tr: παυλος αποστολος ιησου χριστου δια θεληματος θεου κατ επαγγελιαν ζωης της εν χριστω ιησου
kjv: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, according to the promise of life which is in Christ Jesus,

vulg: Timotheo carissimo filio gratia misericordia pax a Deo Patre et Christo Iesu Domino nostro
clem: Timotheo carissimo filio: gratia, misericordia, pax a Deo Patre, et Christo Jesu Domino nostro.
tr: τιμοθεω αγαπητω τεκνω χαρις ελεος ειρηνη απο θεου πατρος και χριστου ιησου του κυριου ημων
kjv: To Timothy, my dearly beloved son: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.

vulg: gratias ago Deo cui servio a progenitoribus in conscientia pura quam sine intermissione habeam tui memoriam in orationibus meis nocte ac die
clem: Gratias ago Deo, cui servio a progenitoribus in conscientia pura, quod sine intermissione habeam tui memoriam in orationibus meis, nocte ac die
tr: χαριν εχω τω θεω ω λατρευω απο προγονων εν καθαρα συνειδησει ως αδιαλειπτον εχω την περι σου μνειαν εν ταις δεησεσιν μου νυκτος και ημερας
kjv: I thank God, whom I serve from my forefathers with pure conscience, that without ceasing I have remembrance of thee in my prayers night and day;

vulg: desiderans te videre memor lacrimarum tuarum ut gaudio implear
clem: desiderans te videre, memor lacrimarum tuarum, ut gaudio implear,
tr: επιποθων σε ιδειν μεμνημενος σου των δακρυων ινα χαρας πληρωθω
kjv: Greatly desiring to see thee, being mindful of thy tears, that I may be filled with joy;

vulg: recordationem accipiens eius fidei quae est in te non ficta quae et habitavit primum in avia tua Loide et matre tua Eunice certus sum autem quod et in te
clem: recordationem accipiens ejus fidei, qu est in te non ficta, qu et habitavit primum in avia tua Loide, et matre tua Eunice, certus sum autem quod et in te.
tr: υπομνησιν λαμβανων της εν σοι ανυποκριτου πιστεως ητις ενωκησεν πρωτον εν τη μαμμη σου λωιδι και τη μητρι σου ευνεικη  ευνικη  πεπεισμαι δε οτι και εν σοι
kjv: When I call to remembrance the unfeigned faith that is in thee, which dwelt first in thy grandmother Lois, and thy mother Eunice; and I am persuaded that in thee also.

vulg: propter quam causam admoneo te ut resuscites gratiam Dei quae est in te per inpositionem manuum mearum
clem: Propter quam causam admoneo te ut resuscites gratiam Dei, qu est in te per impositionem manuum mearum.
tr: δι ην αιτιαν αναμιμνησκω σε αναζωπυρειν το χαρισμα του θεου ο εστιν εν σοι δια της επιθεσεως των χειρων μου
kjv: Wherefore I put thee in remembrance that thou stir up the gift of God, which is in thee by the putting on of my hands.

vulg: non enim dedit nobis Deus spiritum timoris sed virtutis et dilectionis et sobrietatis
clem: Non enim dedit nobis Deus spiritum timoris: sed virtutis, et dilectionis, et sobrietatis.
tr: ου γαρ εδωκεν ημιν ο θεος πνευμα δειλιας αλλα δυναμεως και αγαπης και σωφρονισμου
kjv: For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.

vulg: noli itaque erubescere testimonium Domini nostri neque me vinctum eius sed conlabora evangelio secundum virtutem Dei
clem: Noli itaque erubescere testimonium Domini nostri, neque me vinctum ejus: sed collabora Evangelio secundum virtutem Dei:
tr: μη ουν επαισχυνθης το μαρτυριον του κυριου ημων μηδε εμε τον δεσμιον αυτου αλλα συγκακοπαθησον τω ευαγγελιω κατα δυναμιν θεου
kjv: Be not thou therefore ashamed of the testimony of our Lord, nor of me his prisoner: but be thou partaker of the afflictions of the gospel according to the power of God;

vulg: qui nos liberavit et vocavit vocatione sancta non secundum opera nostra sed secundum propositum suum et gratiam quae data est nobis in Christo Iesu ante tempora saecularia
clem: qui nos liberavit, et vocavit vocatione sua sancta, non secundum opera nostra, sed secundum propositum suum, et gratiam, qu data est nobis in Christo Jesu ante tempora scularia.
tr: του σωσαντος ημας και καλεσαντος κλησει αγια ου κατα τα εργα ημων αλλα κατ ιδιαν προθεσιν και χαριν την δοθεισαν ημιν εν χριστω ιησου προ χρονων αιωνιων
kjv: Who hath saved us, and called us with an holy calling, not according to our works, but according to his own purpose and grace, which was given us in Christ Jesus before the world began,

vulg: manifestata est autem nunc per inluminationem salvatoris nostri Iesu Christi qui destruxit quidem mortem inluminavit autem vitam et incorruptionem per evangelium
clem: Manifestata est autem nunc per illuminationem Salvatoris nostri Jesu Christi, qui destruxit quidem mortem, illuminavit autem vitam, et incorruptionem per Evangelium:
tr: φανερωθεισαν δε νυν δια της επιφανειας του σωτηρος ημων ιησου χριστου καταργησαντος μεν τον θανατον φωτισαντος δε ζωην και αφθαρσιαν δια του ευαγγελιου
kjv: But is now made manifest by the appearing of our Saviour Jesus Christ, who hath abolished death, and hath brought life and immortality to light through the gospel:

vulg: in quo positus sum ego praedicator et apostolus et magister gentium
clem: in quo positus sum ego prdicator, et Apostolus, et magister gentium.
tr: εις ο ετεθην εγω κηρυξ και αποστολος και διδασκαλος εθνων
kjv: Whereunto I am appointed a preacher, and an apostle, and a teacher of the Gentiles.

vulg: ob quam causam etiam haec patior sed non confundor scio enim cui credidi et certus sum quia potens est depositum meum servare in illum diem
clem: Ob quam causam etiam hc patior, sed non confundor. Scio enim cui credidi, et certus sum quia potens est depositum meum servare in illum diem.
tr: δι ην αιτιαν και ταυτα πασχω αλλ ουκ επαισχυνομαι οιδα γαρ ω πεπιστευκα και πεπεισμαι οτι δυνατος εστιν την παραθηκην μου φυλαξαι εις εκεινην την ημεραν
kjv: For the which cause I also suffer these things: nevertheless I am not ashamed: for I know whom I have believed, and am persuaded that he is able to keep that which I have committed unto him against that day.

vulg: formam habe sanorum verborum quae a me audisti in fide et dilectione in Christo Iesu
clem: Formam habe sanorum verborum, qu a me audisti in fide, et in dilectione in Christo Jesu.
tr: υποτυπωσιν εχε υγιαινοντων λογων ων παρ εμου ηκουσας εν πιστει και αγαπη τη εν χριστω ιησου
kjv: Hold fast the form of sound words, which thou hast heard of me, in faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.

vulg: bonum depositum custodi per Spiritum Sanctum qui habitat in nobis
clem: Bonum depositum custodi per Spiritum Sanctum, qui habitat in nobis.
tr: την καλην παρακαταθηκην φυλαξον δια πνευματος αγιου του ενοικουντος εν ημιν
kjv: That good thing which was committed unto thee keep by the Holy Ghost which dwelleth in us.

vulg: scis hoc quod aversi sunt a me omnes qui in Asia sunt ex quibus est Phygelus et Hermogenes
clem: Scis hoc, quod aversi sunt a me omnes, qui in Asia sunt, ex quibus est Phigellus, et Hermogenes.
tr: οιδας τουτο οτι απεστραφησαν με παντες οι εν τη ασια ων εστιν φυγελλος και ερμογενης
kjv: This thou knowest, that all they which are in Asia be turned away from me; of whom are Phygellus and Hermogenes.

vulg: det misericordiam Dominus Onesifori domui quia saepe me refrigeravit et catenam meam non erubuit
clem: Det misericordiam Dominus Onesiphori domui: quia spe me refrigeravit, et catenam meam non erubuit:
tr: δωη ελεος ο κυριος τω ονησιφορου οικω οτι πολλακις με ανεψυξεν και την αλυσιν μου ουκ επησχυνθη
kjv: The Lord give mercy unto the house of Onesiphorus; for he oft refreshed me, and was not ashamed of my chain:

vulg: sed cum Romam venisset sollicite me quaesivit et invenit
clem: sed cum Romam venisset, sollicite me qusivit, et invenit.
tr: αλλα γενομενος εν ρωμη σπουδαιοτερον εζητησεν με και ευρεν
kjv: But, when he was in Rome, he sought me out very diligently, and found me.

vulg: det illi Dominus invenire misericordiam a Domino in illa die et quanta Ephesi ministravit melius tu nosti
clem: Det illi Dominus invenire misericordiam a Domino in illa die. Et quanta Ephesi ministravit mihi, tu melius nosti.
tr: δωη αυτω ο κυριος ευρειν ελεος παρα κυριου εν εκεινη τη ημερα και οσα εν εφεσω διηκονησεν βελτιον συ γινωσκεις
kjv: The Lord grant unto him that he may find mercy of the Lord in that day: and in how many things he ministered unto me at Ephesus, thou knowest very well.

vulg: tu ergo fili mi confortare in gratia quae est in Christo Iesu
clem: Tu ergo fili mi, confortare in gratia, qu est in Christo Jesu:
tr: συ ουν τεκνον μου ενδυναμου εν τη χαριτι τη εν χριστω ιησου
kjv: Thou therefore, my son, be strong in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.

vulg: et quae audisti a me per multos testes haec commenda fidelibus hominibus qui idonei erunt et alios docere
clem: et qu audisti a me per multos testes, hc commenda fidelibus hominibus, qui idonei erant et alios docere.
tr: και α ηκουσας παρ εμου δια πολλων μαρτυρων ταυτα παραθου πιστοις ανθρωποις οιτινες ικανοι εσονται και ετερους διδαξαι
kjv: And the things that thou hast heard of me among many witnesses, the same commit thou to faithful men, who shall be able to teach others also.

vulg: labora sicut bonus miles Christi Iesu
clem: Labora sicut bonus miles Christi Jesu.
tr: συ ουν κακοπαθησον ως καλος στρατιωτης ιησου χριστου
kjv: Thou therefore endure hardness, as a good soldier of Jesus Christ.

vulg: nemo militans inplicat se negotiis saecularibus ut ei placeat cui se probavit
clem: Nemo militans Deo implicat se negotiis scularibus: ut ei placeat, cui se probavit.
tr: ουδεις στρατευομενος εμπλεκεται ταις του βιου πραγματειαις ινα τω στρατολογησαντι αρεση
kjv: No man that warreth entangleth himself with the affairs of this life; that he may please him who hath chosen him to be a soldier.

vulg: nam et qui certat in agone non coronatur nisi legitime certaverit
clem: Nam et qui certat in agone, non coronatur nisi legitime certaverit.
tr: εαν δε και αθλη τις ου στεφανουται εαν μη νομιμως αθληση
kjv: And if a man also strive for masteries, yet is he not crowned, except he strive lawfully.

vulg: laborantem agricolam oportet primum de fructibus accipere
clem: Laborantem agricolam oportet primum de fructibus percipere.
tr: τον κοπιωντα γεωργον δει πρωτον  των καρπων μεταλαμβανειν
kjv: The husbandman that laboureth must be first partaker of the fruits.

vulg: intellege quae dico dabit enim tibi Dominus in omnibus intellectum
clem: Intellige qu dico: dabit enim tibi Dominus in omnibus intellectum.
tr: νοει α λεγω δωη γαρ σοι ο κυριος συνεσιν εν πασιν
kjv: Consider what I say; and the Lord give thee understanding in all things.

vulg: memor esto Iesum Christum resurrexisse a mortuis ex semine David secundum evangelium meum
clem: Memor esto Dominum Jesum Christum resurrexisse a mortuis ex semine David, secundum Evangelium meum,
tr: μνημονευε ιησουν χριστον εγηγερμενον εκ νεκρων εκ σπερματος δαβιδ κατα το ευαγγελιον μου
kjv: Remember that Jesus Christ of the seed of David was raised from the dead according to my gospel:

vulg: in quo laboro usque ad vincula quasi male operans sed verbum Dei non est alligatum
clem: in quo laboro usque ad vincula, quasi male operans: sed verbum Dei non est alligatum.
tr: εν ω κακοπαθω μεχρι δεσμων ως κακουργος αλλ ο λογος του θεου ου δεδεται
kjv: Wherein I suffer trouble, as an evil doer, even unto bonds; but the word of God is not bound.

vulg: ideo omnia sustineo propter electos ut et ipsi salutem consequantur quae est in Christo Iesu cum gloria caelesti
clem: Ideo omnia sustineo propter electos, ut et ipsi salutem consequantur, qu est in Christo Jesu, cum gloria clesti.
tr: δια τουτο παντα υπομενω δια τους εκλεκτους ινα και αυτοι σωτηριας τυχωσιν της εν χριστω ιησου μετα δοξης αιωνιου
kjv: Therefore I endure all things for the elect's sakes, that they may also obtain the salvation which is in Christ Jesus with eternal glory.

vulg: fidelis sermo nam si conmortui sumus et convivemus
clem: Fidelis sermo: nam si commortui sumus, et convivemus:
tr: πιστος ο λογος ει γαρ συναπεθανομεν και συζησομεν
kjv: It is a faithful saying: For if we be dead with him, we shall also live with him:

vulg: si sustinemus et conregnabimus si negabimus et ille negabit nos
clem: si sustinebimus, et conregnabimus: si negaverimus, et ille negabit nos:
tr: ει υπομενομεν και συμβασιλευσομεν ει αρνουμεθα κακεινος αρνησεται ημας
kjv: If we suffer, we shall also reign with him: if we deny him, he also will deny us:

vulg: si non credimus ille fidelis manet negare se ipsum non potest
clem: si non credimus, ille fidelis permanet, negare seipsum non potest.
tr: ει απιστουμεν εκεινος πιστος μενει αρνησασθαι εαυτον ου δυναται
kjv: If we believe not, yet he abideth faithful: he cannot deny himself.

vulg: haec commone testificans coram Domino noli verbis contendere in nihil utile ad subversionem audientium
clem: Hc commone, testificans coram Domino. Noli contendere verbis: ad nihil enim utile est, nisi ad subversionem audientium.
tr: ταυτα υπομιμνησκε διαμαρτυρομενος ενωπιον του κυριου μη λογομαχειν εις ουδεν χρησιμον επι καταστροφη των ακουοντων
kjv: Of these things put them in remembrance, charging them before the Lord that they strive not about words to no profit, but to the subverting of the hearers.

vulg: sollicite cura te ipsum probabilem exhibere Deo operarium inconfusibilem recte tractantem verbum veritatis
clem: Sollicite cura teipsum probabilem exhibere Deo, operarium inconfusibilem, recte tractantem verbum veritatis.
tr: σπουδασον σεαυτον δοκιμον παραστησαι τω θεω εργατην ανεπαισχυντον ορθοτομουντα τον λογον της αληθειας
kjv: Study to shew thyself approved unto God, a workman that needeth not to be ashamed, rightly dividing the word of truth.

vulg: profana autem inaniloquia devita multum enim proficient ad impietatem
clem: Profana autem et vaniloquia devita: multum enim proficiunt ad impietatem:
tr: τας δε βεβηλους κενοφωνιας περιιστασο επι πλειον γαρ προκοψουσιν ασεβειας
kjv: But shun profane and vain babblings: for they will increase unto more ungodliness.

vulg: et sermo eorum ut cancer serpit ex quibus est Hymeneus et Philetus
clem: et sermo eorum ut cancer serpit: ex quibus est Hymenus et Philetus,
tr: και ο λογος αυτων ως γαγγραινα νομην εξει ων εστιν υμεναιος και φιλητος
kjv: And their word will eat as doth a canker: of whom is Hymenaeus and Philetus;

vulg: qui a veritate exciderunt dicentes resurrectionem iam factam et subvertunt quorundam fidem
clem: qui a veritate exciderunt, dicentes resurrectionem esse jam factam, et subverterunt quorumdam fidem.
tr: οιτινες περι την αληθειαν ηστοχησαν λεγοντες την αναστασιν ηδη γεγονεναι και ανατρεπουσιν την τινων πιστιν
kjv: Who concerning the truth have erred, saying that the resurrection is past already; and overthrow the faith of some.

vulg: sed firmum fundamentum Dei stetit habens signaculum hoc cognovit Dominus qui sunt eius et discedat ab iniquitate omnis qui nominat nomen Domini
clem: Sed firmum fundamentum Dei stat, habens signaculum hoc: cognovit Dominus qui sunt ejus, et discedat ab iniquitate omnis qui nominat nomen Domini.
tr: ο μεντοι στερεος θεμελιος του θεου εστηκεν εχων την σφραγιδα ταυτην εγνω κυριος τους οντας αυτου και αποστητω απο αδικιας πας ο ονομαζων το ονομα χριστου
kjv: Nevertheless the foundation of God standeth sure, having this seal, The Lord knoweth them that are his. And, let every one that nameth the name of Christ depart from iniquity.

vulg: in magna autem domo non solum sunt vasa aurea et argentea sed et lignea et fictilia et quaedam quidem in honorem quaedam autem in contumeliam
clem: In magna autem domo non solum sunt vasa aurea, et argentea, sed et lignea, et fictilia: et qudam quidem in honorem, qudam autem in contumeliam.
tr: εν μεγαλη δε οικια ουκ εστιν μονον σκευη χρυσα και αργυρα αλλα και ξυλινα και οστρακινα και α μεν εις τιμην α δε εις ατιμιαν
kjv: But in a great house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver, but also of wood and of earth; and some to honour, and some to dishonour.

vulg: si quis ergo emundaverit se ab istis erit vas in honorem sanctificatum et utile Domino ad omne opus bonum paratum
clem: Si quis ergo emundaverit se ab istis, erit vas in honorem sanctificatum, et utile Domino ad omne opus bonum paratum.
tr: εαν ουν τις εκκαθαρη εαυτον απο τουτων εσται σκευος εις τιμην ηγιασμενον και ευχρηστον τω δεσποτη εις παν εργον αγαθον ητοιμασμενον
kjv: If a man therefore purge himself from these, he shall be a vessel unto honour, sanctified, and meet for the master's use, and prepared unto every good work.

vulg: iuvenilia autem desideria fuge sectare vero iustitiam fidem caritatem pacem cum his qui invocant Dominum de corde puro
clem: Juvenilia autem desideria fuge, sectare vero justitiam, fidem, spem, caritatem, et pacem cum iis qui invocant Dominum de corde puro.
tr: τας δε νεωτερικας επιθυμιας φευγε διωκε δε δικαιοσυνην πιστιν αγαπην ειρηνην μετα των επικαλουμενων τον κυριον εκ καθαρας καρδιας
kjv: Flee also youthful lusts: but follow righteousness, faith, charity, peace, with them that call on the Lord out of a pure heart.

vulg: stultas autem et sine disciplina quaestiones devita sciens quia generant lites
clem: Stultas autem et sine disciplina qustiones devita: sciens quia generant lites.
tr: τας δε μωρας και απαιδευτους ζητησεις παραιτου ειδως οτι γεννωσιν μαχας
kjv: But foolish and unlearned questions avoid, knowing that they do gender strifes.

vulg: servum autem Domini non oportet litigare sed mansuetum esse ad omnes docibilem patientem
clem: Servum autem Domini non oportet litigare: sed mansuetum esse ad omnes, docibilem, patientem,
tr: δουλον δε κυριου ου δει μαχεσθαι αλλ ηπιον ειναι προς παντας διδακτικον ανεξικακον
kjv: And the servant of the Lord must not strive; but be gentle unto all men, apt to teach, patient,

vulg: cum modestia corripientem eos qui resistunt nequando det illis Deus paenitentiam ad cognoscendam veritatem
clem: cum modestia corripientem eos qui resistunt veritati, nequando Deus det illis pnitentiam ad cognoscendam veritatem,
tr: εν πραοτητι παιδευοντα τους αντιδιατιθεμενους μηποτε δω αυτοις ο θεος μετανοιαν εις επιγνωσιν αληθειας
kjv: In meekness instructing those that oppose themselves; if God peradventure will give them repentance to the acknowledging of the truth;

vulg: et resipiscant a diaboli laqueis a quo capti tenentur ad ipsius voluntatem
clem: et resipiscant a diaboli laqueis, a quo captivi tenentur ad ipsius voluntatem.
tr: και ανανηψωσιν εκ της του διαβολου παγιδος εζωγρημενοι υπ αυτου εις το εκεινου θελημα
kjv: And that they may recover themselves out of the snare of the devil, who are taken captive by him at his will.

vulg: hoc autem scito quod in novissimis diebus instabunt tempora periculosa
clem: Hoc autem scito, quod in novissimis diebus instabunt tempora periculosa:
tr: τουτο δε γινωσκε οτι εν εσχαταις ημεραις ενστησονται καιροι χαλεποι
kjv: This know also, that in the last days perilous times shall come.

vulg: et erunt homines se ipsos amantes cupidi elati superbi blasphemi parentibus inoboedientes ingrati scelesti
clem: erunt homines seipsos amantes, cupidi, elati, superbi, blasphemi, parentibus non obedientes, ingrati, scelesti,
tr: εσονται γαρ οι ανθρωποι φιλαυτοι φιλαργυροι αλαζονες υπερηφανοι βλασφημοι γονευσιν απειθεις αχαριστοι ανοσιοι
kjv: For men shall be lovers of their own selves, covetous, boasters, proud, blasphemers, disobedient to parents, unthankful, unholy,

vulg: sine affectione sine pace criminatores incontinentes inmites sine benignitate
clem: sine affectione, sine pace, criminatores, incontinentes, immites, sine benignitate,
tr: αστοργοι ασπονδοι διαβολοι ακρατεις ανημεροι αφιλαγαθοι
kjv: Without natural affection, trucebreakers, false accusers, incontinent, fierce, despisers of those that are good,

vulg: proditores protervi tumidi voluptatium amatores magis quam Dei
clem: proditores, protervi, tumidi, et voluptatum amatores magis quam Dei:
tr: προδοται προπετεις τετυφωμενοι φιληδονοι μαλλον η φιλοθεοι
kjv: Traitors, heady, highminded, lovers of pleasures more than lovers of God;

vulg: habentes speciem quidem pietatis virtutem autem eius abnegantes et hos devita
clem: habentes speciem quidem pietatis, virtutem autem ejus abnegantes. Et hos devita:
tr: εχοντες μορφωσιν ευσεβειας την δε δυναμιν αυτης ηρνημενοι και τουτους αποτρεπου
kjv: Having a form of godliness, but denying the power thereof: from such turn away.

vulg: ex his enim sunt qui penetrant domos et captivas ducunt mulierculas oneratas peccatis quae ducuntur variis desideriis
clem: ex his enim sunt qui penetrant domos, et captivas ducunt mulierculas oneratas peccatis, qu ducuntur variis desideriis:
tr: εκ τουτων γαρ εισιν οι ενδυνοντες εις τας οικιας και αιχμαλωτευοντες τα γυναικαρια σεσωρευμενα αμαρτιαις αγομενα επιθυμιαις ποικιλαις
kjv: For of this sort are they which creep into houses, and lead captive silly women laden with sins, led away with divers lusts,

vulg: semper discentes et numquam ad scientiam veritatis pervenientes
clem: semper discentes, et numquam ad scientiam veritatis pervenientes.
tr: παντοτε μανθανοντα και μηδεποτε εις επιγνωσιν αληθειας ελθειν δυναμενα
kjv: Ever learning, and never able to come to the knowledge of the truth.

vulg: quemadmodum autem Iannes et Mambres restiterunt Mosi ita et hii resistunt veritati homines corrupti mente reprobi circa fidem
clem: Quemadmodum autem Jannes et Mambres restiterunt Moysi: ita et hi resistunt veritati, homines corrupti mente, reprobi circa fidem;
tr: ον τροπον δε ιαννης και ιαμβρης αντεστησαν μωυσει ουτως και ουτοι ανθιστανται τη αληθεια ανθρωποι κατεφθαρμενοι τον νουν αδοκιμοι περι την πιστιν
kjv: Now as Jannes and Jambres withstood Moses, so do these also resist the truth: men of corrupt minds, reprobate concerning the faith.

vulg: sed ultra non proficient insipientia enim eorum manifesta erit omnibus sicut et illorum fuit
clem: sed ultra non proficient: insipientia enim eorum manifesta erit omnibus, sicut et illorum fuit.
tr: αλλ ου προκοψουσιν επι πλειον η γαρ ανοια αυτων εκδηλος εσται πασιν ως και η εκεινων εγενετο
kjv: But they shall proceed no further: for their folly shall be manifest unto all men, as their's also was.

vulg: tu autem adsecutus es meam doctrinam institutionem propositum fidem longanimitatem dilectionem patientiam
clem: Tu autem assecutus es meam doctrinam, institutionem, propositum, fidem, longanimitatem, dilectionem, patientiam,
tr: συ δε παρηκολουθηκας μου τη διδασκαλια τη αγωγη τη προθεσει τη πιστει τη μακροθυμια τη αγαπη τη υπομονη
kjv: But thou hast fully known my doctrine, manner of life, purpose, faith, longsuffering, charity, patience,

vulg: persecutiones passiones qualia mihi facta sunt Antiochiae Iconii Lystris quales persecutiones sustinui et ex omnibus me eripuit Dominus
clem: persecutiones, passiones: qualia mihi facta sunt Antiochi, Iconii, et Lystris: quales persecutiones sustinui, et ex omnibus eripuit me Dominus.
tr: τοις διωγμοις τοις παθημασιν οια μοι εγενετο εν αντιοχεια εν ικονιω εν λυστροις οιους διωγμους υπηνεγκα και εκ παντων με ερρυσατο ο κυριος
kjv: Persecutions, afflictions, which came unto me at Antioch, at Iconium, at Lystra; what persecutions I endured: but out of them all the Lord delivered me.

vulg: et omnes qui volunt pie vivere in Christo Iesu persecutionem patientur
clem: Et omnes, qui pie volunt vivere in Christo Jesu, persecutionem patientur.
tr: και παντες δε οι θελοντες ευσεβως ζην εν χριστω ιησου διωχθησονται
kjv: Yea, and all that will live godly in Christ Jesus shall suffer persecution.

vulg: mali autem homines et seductores proficient in peius errantes et in errorem mittentes
clem: Mali autem homines et seductores proficient in pejus, errantes, et in errorem mittentes.
tr: πονηροι δε ανθρωποι και γοητες προκοψουσιν επι το χειρον πλανωντες και πλανωμενοι
kjv: But evil men and seducers shall wax worse and worse, deceiving, and being deceived.

vulg: tu vero permane in his quae didicisti et credita sunt tibi sciens a quo didiceris
clem: Tu vero permane in iis qu didicisti, et credita sunt tibi: sciens a quo didiceris:
tr: συ δε μενε εν οις εμαθες και επιστωθης ειδως παρα τινος εμαθες
kjv: But continue thou in the things which thou hast learned and hast been assured of, knowing of whom thou hast learned them;

vulg: et quia ab infantia sacras litteras nosti quae te possint instruere ad salutem per fidem quae est in Christo Iesu
clem: et quia ab infantia sacras litteras nosti, qu te possunt instruere ad salutem, per fidem qu est in Christo Jesu.
tr: και οτι απο βρεφους τα ιερα γραμματα οιδας τα δυναμενα σε σοφισαι εις σωτηριαν δια πιστεως της εν χριστω ιησου
kjv: And that from a child thou hast known the holy scriptures, which are able to make thee wise unto salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus.

vulg: omnis scriptura divinitus inspirata et utilis ad docendum ad arguendum ad corrigendum ad erudiendum in iustitia
clem: Omnis Scriptura divinitus inspirata utilis est ad docendum, ad arguendum, ad corripiendum, et erudiendum in justitia:
tr: πασα γραφη θεοπνευστος και ωφελιμος προς διδασκαλιαν προς ελεγχον προς επανορθωσιν προς παιδειαν την εν δικαιοσυνη
kjv: All scripture is given by inspiration of God, and is profitable for doctrine, for reproof, for correction, for instruction in righteousness:

vulg: ut perfectus sit homo Dei ad omne opus bonum instructus
clem: ut perfectus sit homo Dei, ad omne opus bonum instructus.
tr: ινα αρτιος η ο του θεου ανθρωπος προς παν εργον αγαθον εξηρτισμενος
kjv: That the man of God may be perfect, thoroughly furnished unto all good works.

vulg: testificor coram Deo et Christo Iesu qui iudicaturus est vivos ac mortuos et adventum ipsius et regnum eius
clem: Testificor coram Deo, et Jesu Christo, qui judicaturus est vivos et mortuos, per adventum ipsius, et regnum ejus:
tr: διαμαρτυρομαι ουν εγω ενωπιον του θεου και του κυριου ιησου χριστου του μελλοντος κρινειν ζωντας και νεκρους κατα την επιφανειαν αυτου και την βασιλειαν αυτου
kjv: I charge thee therefore before God, and the Lord Jesus Christ, who shall judge the quick and the dead at his appearing and his kingdom;

vulg: praedica verbum insta oportune inportune argue obsecra increpa in omni patientia et doctrina
clem: prdica verbum, insta opportune, importune: argue, obsecra, increpa in omni patientia, et doctrina.
tr: κηρυξον τον λογον επιστηθι ευκαιρως ακαιρως ελεγξον επιτιμησον παρακαλεσον εν παση μακροθυμια και διδαχη
kjv: Preach the word; be instant in season, out of season; reprove, rebuke, exhort with all long suffering and doctrine.

vulg: erit enim tempus cum sanam doctrinam non sustinebunt sed ad sua desideria coacervabunt sibi magistros prurientes auribus
clem: Erit enim tempus, cum sanam doctrinam non sustinebunt, sed ad sua desideria coacervabunt sibi magistros, prurientes auribus,
tr: εσται γαρ καιρος οτε της υγιαινουσης διδασκαλιας ουκ ανεξονται αλλα κατα τας επιθυμιας τας ιδιας εαυτοις επισωρευσουσιν διδασκαλους κνηθομενοι την ακοην
kjv: For the time will come when they will not endure sound doctrine; but after their own lusts shall they heap to themselves teachers, having itching ears;

vulg: et a veritate quidem auditum avertent ad fabulas autem convertentur
clem: et a veritate quidem auditum avertent, ad fabulas autem convertentur.
tr: και απο μεν της αληθειας την ακοην αποστρεψουσιν επι δε τους μυθους εκτραπησονται
kjv: And they shall turn away their ears from the truth, and shall be turned unto fables.

vulg: tu vero vigila in omnibus labora opus fac evangelistae ministerium tuum imple
clem: Tu vero vigila, in omnibus labora, opus fac evangelist, ministerium tuum imple. Sobrius esto.
tr: συ δε νηφε εν πασιν κακοπαθησον εργον ποιησον ευαγγελιστου την διακονιαν σου πληροφορησον
kjv: But watch thou in all things, endure afflictions, do the work of an evangelist, make full proof of thy ministry.

vulg: ego enim iam delibor et tempus meae resolutionis instat
clem: Ego enim jam delibor, et tempus resolutionis me instat.
tr: εγω γαρ ηδη σπενδομαι και ο καιρος της εμης αναλυσεως εφεστηκεν
kjv: For I am now ready to be offered, and the time of my departure is at hand.

vulg: bonum certamen certavi cursum consummavi fidem servavi
clem: Bonum certamen certavi, cursum consummavi, fidem servavi.
tr: τον αγωνα τον καλον ηγωνισμαι τον δρομον τετελεκα την πιστιν τετηρηκα
kjv: I have fought a good fight, I have finished my course, I have kept the faith:

vulg: in reliquo reposita est mihi iustitiae corona quam reddet mihi Dominus in illa die iustus iudex non solum autem mihi sed et his qui diligunt adventum eius
clem: In reliquo reposita est mihi corona justiti, quam reddet mihi Dominus in illa die, justus judex: non solum autem mihi, sed et iis, qui diligunt adventum ejus. Festina ad me venire cito.
tr: λοιπον αποκειται μοι ο της δικαιοσυνης στεφανος ον αποδωσει μοι ο κυριος εν εκεινη τη ημερα ο δικαιος κριτης ου μονον δε εμοι αλλα και πασιν τοις ηγαπηκοσιν την επιφανειαν αυτου
kjv: Henceforth there is laid up for me a crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous judge, shall give me at that day: and not to me only, but unto all them also that love his appearing.

vulg: festina venire ad me cito
clem: Demas enim me reliquit, diligens hoc sculum, et abiit Thessalonicam:
tr: σπουδασον ελθειν προς με ταχεως
kjv: Do thy diligence to come shortly unto me:

vulg: Demas enim me dereliquit diligens hoc saeculum et abiit Thessalonicam Crescens in Galliam Titus in Dalmatiam
clem: Crescens in Galatiam, Titus in Dalmatiam.
tr: δημας γαρ με εγκατελιπεν αγαπησας τον νυν αιωνα και επορευθη εις θεσσαλονικην κρησκης εις γαλατιαν τιτος εις δαλματιαν
kjv: For Demas hath forsaken me, having loved this present world, and is departed unto Thessalonica; Crescens to Galatia, Titus unto Dalmatia.

vulg: Lucas est mecum solus Marcum adsume et adduc tecum est enim mihi utilis in ministerium
clem: Lucas est mecum solus. Marcum assume, et adduc tecum: est enim mihi utilis in ministerium.
tr: λουκας εστιν μονος μετ εμου μαρκον αναλαβων αγε μετα σεαυτου εστιν γαρ μοι ευχρηστος εις διακονιαν
kjv: Only Luke is with me. Take Mark, and bring him with thee: for he is profitable to me for the ministry.

vulg: Tychicum autem misi Ephesum
clem: Tychicum autem misi Ephesum.
tr: τυχικον δε απεστειλα εις εφεσον
kjv: And Tychicus have I sent to Ephesus.

vulg: paenulam quam reliqui Troade apud Carpum veniens adfers et libros maxime autem membranas
clem: Penulam, quam reliqui Troade apud Carpum, veniens affer tecum, et libros, maxime autem membranas.
tr: τον φαιλονην  φελονην  ον απελιπον εν τρωαδι παρα καρπω ερχομενος φερε και τα βιβλια μαλιστα τας μεμβρανας
kjv: The cloke that I left at Troas with Carpus, when thou comest, bring with thee, and the books, but especially the parchments.

vulg: Alexander aerarius multa mala mihi ostendit reddat ei Dominus secundum opera eius
clem: Alexander rarius multa mala mihi ostendit: reddet illi Dominus secundum opera ejus:
tr: αλεξανδρος ο χαλκευς πολλα μοι κακα ενεδειξατο αποδωη αυτω ο κυριος κατα τα εργα αυτου
kjv: Alexander the coppersmith did me much evil: the Lord reward him according to his works:

vulg: quem et tu devita valde enim restitit verbis nostris
clem: quem et tu devita: valde enim restitit verbis nostris.
tr: ον και συ φυλασσου λιαν γαρ ανθεστηκεν τοις ημετεροις λογοις
kjv: Of whom be thou ware also; for he hath greatly withstood our words.

vulg: in prima mea defensione nemo mihi adfuit sed omnes me dereliquerunt non illis reputetur
clem: In prima mea defensione nemo mihi affuit, sed omnes me dereliquerunt: non illis imputetur.
tr: εν τη πρωτη μου απολογια ουδεις μοι συμπαρεγενετο αλλα παντες με εγκατελιπον μη αυτοις λογισθειη
kjv: At my first answer no man stood with me, but all men forsook me: I pray God that it may not be laid to their charge.

vulg: Dominus autem mihi adstitit et confortavit me ut per me praedicatio impleatur et audiant omnes gentes et liberatus sum de ore leonis
clem: Dominus autem mihi astitit, et confortavit me, ut per me prdicatio impleatur, et audiant omnes gentes: et liberatus sum de ore leonis.
tr: ο δε κυριος μοι παρεστη και ενεδυναμωσεν με ινα δι εμου το κηρυγμα πληροφορηθη και ακουση παντα τα εθνη και ερρυσθην εκ στοματος λεοντος
kjv: Notwithstanding the Lord stood with me, and strengthened me; that by me the preaching might be fully known, and that all the Gentiles might hear: and I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion.

vulg: liberabit me Dominus ab omni opere malo et salvum faciet in regnum suum caeleste cui gloria in saecula saeculorum amen
clem: Liberavit me Dominus ab omni opere malo: et salvum faciet in regnum suum cleste, cui gloria in scula sculorum. Amen.
tr: και ρυσεται με ο κυριος απο παντος εργου πονηρου και σωσει εις την βασιλειαν αυτου την επουρανιον ω η δοξα εις τους αιωνας των αιωνων αμην
kjv: And the Lord shall deliver me from every evil work, and will preserve me unto his heavenly kingdom: to whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.

vulg: saluta Priscam et Aquilam et Onesifori domum
clem: Saluta Priscam, et Aquilam, et Onesiphori domum.
tr: ασπασαι πρισκαν και ακυλαν και τον ονησιφορου οικον
kjv: Salute Prisca and Aquila, and the household of Onesiphorus.

vulg: Erastus remansit Corinthi Trophimum autem reliqui infirmum Mileti
clem: Erastus remansit Corinthi. Trophimum autem reliqui infirmum Mileti.
tr: εραστος εμεινεν εν κορινθω τροφιμον δε απελιπον εν μιλητω ασθενουντα
kjv: Erastus abode at Corinth: but Trophimus have I left at Miletum sick.

vulg: festina ante hiemem venire salutat te Eubulus et Pudens et Linus et Claudia et fratres omnes
clem: Festina ante hiemem venire. Salutant te Eubulus, et Pudens, et Linus, et Claudia, et fratres omnes.
tr: σπουδασον προ χειμωνος ελθειν ασπαζεται σε ευβουλος και πουδης και λινος και κλαυδια και οι αδελφοι παντες
kjv: Do thy diligence to come before winter. Eubulus greeteth thee, and Pudens, and Linus, and Claudia, and all the brethren.

vulg: Dominus Iesus cum spiritu tuo gratia nobiscum amen
clem: Dominus Jesus Christus cum spiritu tuo. Gratia vobiscum. Amen.
tr: ο κυριος ιησους χριστος μετα του πνευματος σου η χαρις μεθ υμων αμην [ προς τιμοθεον δευτερα της εφεσιων εκκλησιας πρωτον επισκοπον χειροτονηθεντα εγραφη απο ρωμης οτε εκ δευτερου παρεστη παυλος τω καισαρι νερωνι]
kjv: The Lord Jesus Christ be with thy spirit. Grace be with you. Amen.
